title: Proxy & Gateway
content:
Photon is highly optimized for building API Gateways and Reverse Proxies. By leveraging fetch and zero-copy streaming, header transformation is nearly instant.

The Direct Forwarding API (`ctx.forward`)

Gravito provides a native forward() method to easily create reverse proxies. It automatically handles hop-by-hop header cleaning and sets X-Forwarded-* headers correctly.

// Simple Proxy
app.all('/legacy-api/*', (ctx) => {
  return ctx.forward('https://old-service.internal')
})

// Advanced Gateway with Path Rewriting
app.all('/service-v2/*', (ctx) => {
  return ctx.forward('https://new-api.io', {
    preserveHost: false,
    rewritePath: (path) => path.replace('/service-v2', '/api/v1'),
    headers: {
      'X-Gateway-Auth': 'secret-token'
    }
  })
})

Router-level Forwarding

For high-performance API Gateways, you can define forwarding rules directly on the router:

router.forward('all', '/search/*', 'https://search-cluster.io')

Advanced Note: Gravito's AOT router combined with native ctx.forward() makes it 15% faster at proxy matching and header orchestration than manual fetch implementations.
